entry_surfaces./login: PIN Gate Passcode Lock screen — centered scholarly security vault with warm ivory backdrop, floating subtle 3D geometric ring mesh, and quick demo pin button (PIN: 1947 or 2026)
entry_surfaces./: Asymmetric Executive Dashboard — Top status banner with study streak + daily target meter, left dominant 8-col grid (Study ring progress, today's focus timer, 7-day study velocity chart, upcoming spaced revisions), right 4-col rail (Mock test trend radar, subject mastery bars, active goals, quick session logger)
entry_surfaces./sessions: Study Logbook & Timer — Top live pomodoro/stopwatch tracker with subject selector, followed by a filterable editorial log table with notes, duration, tags, and revision scheduling
entry_surfaces./goals: Strategic Milestones & UPSC GS/Prelims Roadmap — Grid of syllabus target cards with percentage rings, target completion dates, sub-task checklists, and priority badges
entry_surfaces./revisions: Spaced Repetition Queue (SuperMemo-inspired UPSC revision) — Due today vs Upcoming 7-day queue, subject filter pills, 1-click 'Mark Revised' with retention score selector (Easy/Good/Hard)
entry_surfaces./tests: Mock Test & Prelims/Mains Practice Analytics — Test record modal, score distribution trend line (GS1 & CSAT), accuracy breakdown, topic weakness analysis
entry_surfaces./subjects: Syllabus Matrix & Mastery Tracker — Expandable GS Paper I, II, III, IV & Optional subject modules with progress bars, completed subtopics, and linked session history
entry_surfaces./insights: Productivity Intelligence — Hourly study heatmaps, best time-of-day analytics, subject balance radar/donut, weekly velocity comparison
entry_surfaces./settings: Preferences & Notion Database Sync Hub — Notion API key & Database ID setup, two-way sync simulation, data export/import (JSON/CSV), PIN passcode configuration, Seed data reset

3d_element.type: Interactive Subtle 3D Geometric Ring / Wireframe Polyhedron in Hero/Background
3d_element.implementation: Three.js / React Three Fiber lightweight canvas or CSS 3D Particle Orbit with transparent canvas background (alpha: true). Rotates gently with mouse movement, representing disciplined focus and progress rings.
3d_element.lighting: Warm ambient light (#FFF8EE) + subtle directional amber key light with low intensity so text remains 100% crisp and readable.
3d_element.performance: Pointer-events-none, z-0 background overlay, pauses on mobile or when window is blurred.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle 2% noise / editorial paper stipple pattern on `#FBF9F4` page background to evoke UPSC standard archival paper & civil services books.
visual_enhancers.border_style: 1px crisp `#E8E3D7` hairline borders with subtle `#F0EDE5` inner shadows on cards.
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill-shaped badges with font-mono overlines, e.g., 'GS-II: POLITY' in forest green, 'REVISION DUE' in saffron amber.

navigation_structure.header: Sticky Glassmorphism Nav (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FBF9F4]/90 border-b border-[#E8E3D7] z-40`)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this entire guidelines file and strictly maintain the Warm Editorial Light theme (#FBF9F4 ivory, #1C1D18 ink, #C8640E saffron accent, #1D3A2C forest green).
2. Use Lora for headers/brand (`--font-heading`), DM Sans for body (`--font-sans`), and JetBrains Mono for metrics/codes (`--font-mono`). Fonts are already pre-installed in `@fontsource-variable/*`.
3. Build a beautiful 3D ambient element in the background or hero (using Three.js / Canvas or CSS 3D Rings) that is lightweight and transparent.

4. Implement the PIN gate: When user opens the site for the first time or clicks Lock, show the PIN Gate screen. Provide a 1-click 'Unlock with Demo PIN (1947)' button so testing subagents and evaluators can bypass it immediately without friction.
5. Include full CRUD/interactive features for Study Sessions, Goals, Revision Queue (spaced repetition), Mock Tests, and Subject Syllabus Matrix.

6. Build the dedicated Notion Database Sync settings page with simulated API connection, field mapping cards, and sync logs (explicitly marked MOCKED sync capability with real working local persistence).
7. Add realistic UPSC seed data (GS1-4, PSIR optional, Prelims mock tests with 110-135 score ranges, spaced revisions for Laxmikanth, Spectrum Modern History, Shankar IAS Environment, etc.).
8. Ensure every button, input, tab, and card has explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid="quick-log-session-btn"`, `data-testid="pin-key-1"`, `data-testid="revision-item-1"`).
